_note: unisexperfume (blibli/shopee/lazada/tokopedia/tiktok ID) writes to the shared `cologne` dataset, exactly like menperfume: cologne.product_id_dict_qa / cologne.cologne_dict / cologne.filter_cologne. cologne_dict columns are brand, sku_type_complete, user_category, keywords, keyword_typo, bundle_type, bundle_quantity -- there is NO _meta column on the dict table, so the harness's 'stamp _meta on the dict insert' step cannot be honoured. sku_type_complete is a BASE column (typed directly, brand-first), not composed from sub_brand/variant/packsize columns. Inferred 2026-09-09 from 8075 live rows (7968 of them match the `keywords` rule below exactly; the remainder are '' or '#REF!' junk).
_keyword_typo: Optional. '' (never NULL) on 8035/8075 rows. When non-empty it holds a common misspelling of the identity.

_sku_type_complete.size_format: '100 ml' (space before unit); multipack suffix ' x N pcs'; unknown variant -> 'Multi Variant'; unknown size -> 'Multi Size'
_sku_type_complete.bundles: Mixed-FORM bundles (fragrance + face wash / pomade / roll-on / hair&body wash) ENUMERATE their components joined by ' + ' and are typed bundle_type='single', bundle_quantity=1.0, with NO ' x N pcs' suffix. Multi-fragrance packs use ' x N pcs' with bundle_type='multipack' and bundle_quantity=N.

_attribute_vocab._user_category_note: Legacy-noisy: 7192 Women / 864 Men / 18 Unisex. Default to 'Women' unless the pack is explicitly a men's or boys' product; do not add to 'Unisex'.
_attribute_vocab.bundle_quantity: FLOAT64; 1.0 for single, N for multipack
